assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: seamless ultra-wide photographic panorama for an interactive balcony scene. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Extend its canvas to the RIGHT ONLY into a comfortably furnished living room, as a natural continuation of the existing open sliding glass doorway. Requested output 3072x1152, panoramic 8:3. The original balcony photograph should occupy roughly the LEFT TWO THIRDS at unchanged proportions, with its city rooftops, trees, black railing, concrete column, wicker armchair, green pillow, draped blanket, round wooden table, ceramic cup and open book all preserved in their original relative positions. Keep the same seated eye level and camera position; this is a wider lens view from the same balcony, not a separate camera or collage. In the new right third reveal a warm intimate living room beyond the existing doorway: a cream linen sofa, a small wood coffee table, pale woven rug, warm wood bookshelf and a shaded reading floor lamp. Match the bookshelf/lamp already glimpsed on the far right of the original. The apartment is comfortable, quiet and lived in, without clutter. Natural daytime blue sky and sunlit rooftops outside, soft indirect daylight inside with gentle warm lamp glow. Straight credible architectural lines, realistic threshold and continuous flooring. Keep all objects sharp and photographic with natural material texture; no illustration or synthetic 3D render appearance. No people, pets, vehicles, visible streets, text, borders, split panels or seam. Do not add steam above the cup or stars; these are animated separately by the app. Do not reposition or shrink the original balcony objects to make room: extend the actual scene to the right.
